selection_rule: twelve outlets of ten countries chosen from the source-discovery inventory for difference, not for ease: four the legacy system had no channel for, four it never got a usable article from, two it read sporadically, two it read well (controls); feeds of four families (WordPress, Arc XP, proprietary RSS, Atom), a feed on a foreign host, a section feed, three kinds of sitemap index, and one HTML listing. Ecuador and Nicaragua, the two countries without a productive legacy outlet, are in it
